name: lem-residual-lower
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-residual-lower — Convex outsourcing: let C be the convex hull of finitely many points of R^n, and suppose p = sum_{j=1}^m c_j p_j + (1 - s) q with points p_j, q in R^n, coefficients c_j >= 0, s = sum_{j=1}^m c_j < 1, and dist_1(p_j, C) <= dist_1(p, C) for every j; then dist_1(p, C) <= dist_1(q, C).
